name: Can tile flooring be installed over existing flooring?

mainEntity.name: Can tile flooring be installed over existing flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: In some cases, tile flooring can be installed over existing flooring, but it depends on the type and condition of the current floor. New tile can often be laid directly over well-bonded, flat, and stable existing tile, provided the subfloor can support the additional weight. However, it is generally not recommended to tile over wood, laminate, or vinyl flooring directly, as these surfaces can be too flexible or expand and contract, leading to cracked grout or tiles. For optimal results, removing the old flooring and preparing the subfloor is usually the best approach.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installing new tile over existing flooring is possible in some situations, especially if the current tile is stable and the subfloor can handle the extra weight. However, direct installation over wood, laminate, or vinyl is generally not recommended.
